why: Health.judge's guard: its two callers never pass a revision past the head: the loop bisects below its snapshot's revision, which is the head, and bisectOn refuses `bad > head` and `good >= bad` before judging (its refusal is pinned by tests/studio-health.test.ts); the guard is a defence for a future caller
Previews' `wanted` is read by the loop and by the end of a run, both started by `schedule()`, which sets it to true first: its initial value is never read

serveAsset: `end` is at most `size - 1` (no range, `Math.min(…, size - 1)` or `size - 1`), so `start >= size` already makes `start > end` true; the second test never decides, and `start === size` is refused by the first (the ranges are pinned by tests/studio-workshop-previews-mutants.test.ts)
Builds.list: `rebuilt` is NULL or the JSON object rebuild() wrote, never an empty string; for NULL the parse of `String(null)`, `'null'`, is null, what the guard returned

Builds.handle: a refused path (null) is neither `/play` nor `/play/`, and the build's pattern run on it reads the string 'null', which it does not match: the answer is the same 404 'not found' a line later

Shipper.close: with `this.every` null (watch never called), `clearInterval(null)` does nothing, so clearing always is the same; the timer cleared when there is one is pinned by tests/studio-backup.test.ts (nothing shipped after close)
